verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              गोपवृद्धस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा शक्रपरिग्रहे। प्रभावज्ञोऽपि शक्रस्य वाक्यं दामोदरोऽब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: अनमित्र's son is scholarly दुलिदुह; and king दिलीप, the great-grandfather of राम, is the son of this दुलिदुह...
verses.bhavadeepa: शक्रस्य विभाविनी पूजयित्री पूजाकाल इत्यर्थः। महैः उत्सवैः॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: वनं वनचरा गोपाः सदा गोधनजीविनः। गावोऽस्मद्दैवतं विद्धि गिरयश्च वनानि च॥२॥
verses.english: Either the protector of merit or the perpetrator of sin will reap one-fourth of the result of their respective actions...

verses.sanskrit: सितवर्णाम्बुदोष्णीषं हंसचामरवीजितम्। पूर्णचन्द्रामलच्छत्रं साभिषेकमिवाम्बरम्॥२-१६-१७॥
verses.english: Either the protector of merit or the perpetrator of sin will reap one-fourth of the result of their respective actions...

verses.sanskrit: कर्षुकाणां कृषिर्वृत्तिः पण्यं विपणिजीविनाम् ।  गावोऽस्माकं परा वृत्तिरेतत्त्रैविद्यमुच्यते ॥२-१६-३॥
verses.english: "How विवस्वत्, the son of आदित्य, the sungod, got the godhood of श्राद्ध-देव, the lord of beautification of manes? How best we can beatify manes? What is the origin of manes and why they are reckoned as manes? All these things I would like to listen in detail...

verses.sanskrit: विद्यया यो यथा युक्तस्तस्य सा दैवतं परम्। सैव पूज्यार्चनीया च सैव तस्योपकारिणी। योऽन्यस्य फलमश्नानः करोत्यन्यस्य सत्क्रियाम्॥४॥
verses.english: That I will narrate from the start all that bhIShma has elucidated to dharmaja... originally sage सनत्कुमार narrated these topics to sage मार्कन्डेय; then मार्कन्डेय related this to भीष्म, and then भीष्म reiterated the same to धर्मज...

verses.sanskrit: द्वावनर्थौ स लभते प्रेत्य चेह च मानवः। कृष्यन्ता प्रथिता सीमा सीमान्तं श्रूयते वनम्॥५॥
verses.english: As such, all beings like gods, humans, gandharva-s et al will firstly appease that foremost god... and if he is assuaged, all the gods, manes and the rest feel assuaged... whatever is offered in the process of beatification in this world thus belongs and reaches the god a priori, say, via the intermediary manes and gods... in turn they accord benefits to the offerers in some kind or the other to keep up give-and-take syndrome... this is the cycle brahma has ordered...

verses.sanskrit: वनान्ता गिरयः सर्वे सा चास्माकं गतिर्ध्रुवा। श्रूयन्ते गिरयश्चापि वनेऽस्मिन्कामरूपिणः। प्रविश्य तास्तास्तनवो रमन्ते स्वेषु सानुषु॥६॥
verses.english: "We hear that manes are reckoned as gods even by gods proper... then what is the difference between gods and manes... which gods do we worship and which manes do we propitiate... how the manes existing in next-world are beatified with offertories we accord here... all said and done, oh, sire, what is the result of our beatifying the manes...

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा केसरिणः सिंहा व्याघ्राश्च नखिनां वराः। वनानि स्वानि रक्षन्ति त्रासयन्तो वनच्छिदः॥७॥
verses.english: Once sage मार्कण्डेय detailed all these topics to quizzical bhIShma...

verses.sanskrit: यदा चैषां विकुर्वन्ति ते वनालयजीविनः। घ्नन्ति तानेव दुर्वृत्तान्पौरुषादेन कर्मणा॥८॥
verses.english: That I will narrate from the start all that bhIShma has elucidated to dharmaja... originally sage सनत्कुमार narrated these topics to sage मार्कन्डेय; then मार्कन्डेय related this to भीष्म, and then भीष्म reiterated the same to धर्मज...

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयज्ञपरा विप्राः सीतायज्ञाश्च कर्षुकाः। गिरियज्ञास्तथा गोपा इज्योऽस्माभिर्गिरिर्वने॥९॥
verses.english: "Oh, righteous one, how the well-wishers of manes derive prosperity..., and doing what those well-wishers can remain unremorseful... I would like to know about them all..."
verses.bhavadeepa: एषां वनानां विकुर्वन्ति विकारं जनयन्ति। वनालया भिल्लाद्याः वनजीविनो गोपतक्षाद्याः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: तन्मह्यं रोचते गोपा गिरियज्ञः प्रवर्तताम्। कर्म कृत्वा सुखस्थाने पादपेष्वथ वा गिरौ॥१०॥
verses.english: "Manes are beatified just by performing obsequious rites, oh, yudhiShThira, and they accord all fruits of action to the performer to thrive well on this earth as well as in heaven... इह-पर-लोक-सुखम्... and they accord a righteous living to him who desires it... progeny to childless... all-round success to the unavailing few...

verses.sanskrit: तत्र हत्वा पशून्मेध्यान्वितत्यायतने शुभे। सर्वघोषस्य सन्दोहः क्रियतां किं विचार्यते॥११॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the sixteenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the prominence of श्राद्ध-s, beatification of manes.
verses.bhavadeepa: कर्म स्वस्तिवाचनादिकं सुखस्थाने पादपादिसन्निधौ समे देशे॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: तं शरत्कुसुमापीडाः परिवार्य प्रदक्षिणम्। गावो गिरिवरं सर्वास्ततो यान्तु पुनर्व्रजम्॥१२॥
verses.english: When they themselves have fallen into hell, how the hell-bond manes are capable of according benefits to mortals, which mortals' fate of reaching hell or haven is yet undecided... if this category of hell-bound manes do not yield any benefit to mortals, who are the other manes to whom we can make offertories... ultimately, whom we have to adore...
verses.bhavadeepa: वितत्य कुण्डमण्डपादिकं विस्तार्य क्रियताम्। एकत्रेति शेषः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ता किलेयं हि गवां स्वादुतोयतृणा गुणैः। शरत्प्रमुदिता रम्या गतमेघजलाशया॥१३॥
verses.english: We hear that even gods welcome manes in thseir assemblages, oh, grandsire, all these topics I would like to hear in detail from you, hence please tell me all about it... what is to be done to the manes, according to the कल्प-s, corpuses of बोधयन, पराशर et al, in order to negotiate a clean pathway to the obstacle, called this life...

verses.sanskrit: प्रियकैः पुष्पितैर्गौरं श्यामं बाणसनैः क्वचित्। कठोरतृणमाभाति निर्मयूररुतं वनम्॥१४॥
verses.english: "Oh, yes, I will clear all your doubts, bhIShma... you may ask whatever you wish to ask me..." So said king shantanu to bhIShma.

verses.sanskrit: विजला विमला व्योम्नि विबलाका विविद्युतः। विवर्धन्ते जलधरा विदन्ता इव कुञ्जराः॥१५॥
verses.english: When they themselves have fallen into hell, how the hell-bond manes are capable of according benefits to mortals, which mortals' fate of reaching hell or haven is yet undecided... if this category of hell-bound manes do not yield any benefit to mortals, who are the other manes to whom we can make offertories... ultimately, whom we have to adore...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रियकैः कदम्बभेदैः बाणासनैः झिण्टीपुच्छैः निर्मयूररुतं वर्षापगमात्॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: पटुना मेघनादेन नवतोयानुकर्षिणा। पर्णोत्करघनाः सर्वे प्रसादं यान्ति पादपाः॥१६॥
verses.english: Construing this as odd and going against corpuses of beatification, I laid the food offertory on कुश-grass in usual way, without a second thought...

verses.sanskrit: हंसैः प्रहसितानीव समुत्क्रिष्टानि सारसैः। सर्वाणि तनुतां यान्ति जलानि जलदक्षये॥१८॥
verses.english: "What all I have heard I will relate to you... who are the other mans, whom we should propitiate... I have heard these topics from my father, king शन्तनु, who by that time departed to other worlds...

verses.sanskrit: चक्रवाकस्तनतटाः पुलिनश्रोणिमण्डलाः। हंसलक्षणहासिन्यः पतिं यान्ति समुद्रगाः॥१९॥
verses.english: Either the protector of merit or the perpetrator of sin will reap one-fourth of the result of their respective actions...

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदोत्फुल्लमुदकं ताराभिश्चित्रमम्बरम्। सममभ्युत्स्मयन्तीव शर्वरीष्वितरेतरम्॥२०॥
verses.english: Whatever a king does in pursuit of dharma, people bent on dharma will automatically follow it, taking the action of that king as their role model...

verses.sanskrit: मत्तक्रौञ्चावघुष्टेषु कमलापक्वपाण्डुषु। निर्विष्टरमणीयेषु वनेषु रमते मनः॥२१॥
verses.english: Construing this as odd and going against corpuses of beatification, I laid the food offertory on कुश-grass in usual way, without a second thought...

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करिण्यस्तडागानि वाप्यश्च विकचोत्पलाः। केदाराः सरितश्चैव सरांसि च श्रियाज्वलन्॥२२॥
verses.english: Then my father is gladdned and spoke to me in a soft tone while I obsequiously served him...
verses.bhavadeepa: कलमापक्वपाण्डुषु धान्यमञ्जरीपाकपिङ्गेषु निर्विष्टाः कृतविवाहास्तद्वद्रमणीयेषु क्रौञ्चपुरुषयोः धान्यवराङ्गनयोश्च साम्यम्॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: पङ्कजानि च ताम्राणि तथान्यानि सितान्यपि। उत्पलानि च नीलानि भेजिरे वारिजां श्रियम्॥२३॥
verses.english: Besides this, I am ready to accord whatever boon you seek from me... as such, tell me what your heart would wish for..." So said king shantanu to bhIShma.

verses.sanskrit: मदं जहुः सितापाङ्गा मन्दं ववृधिरेऽनिलाः। अभवद्व्यभ्रमाकाशमभूच्च निभृतोऽर्णवः॥२४॥
verses.english: "When I am said like this I obediently spoke to him with folded-palms, 'I feel fulfilled as you are pleased with my manner... If you are kind enough please provide some information for these queries of mine... whether or not I seek answers explicitly or implicitly..." So said bhIShma to king shantanu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुपर्यायशिथिलैर्वृत्तनृत्यसमुज्झितैः। मयूराङ्गरुहैर्भूमिर्बहुनेत्रेव लक्ष्यते॥२५॥
verses.english: "Oh, yes, I will clear all your doubts, bhIShma... you may ask whatever you wish to ask me..." So said king shantanu to bhIShma.

verses.sanskrit: स्वपङ्कमलिनैस्तीरैः काशपुष्पलताकुलैः। हंससारसविन्यासैर्यमुना भाति शोभना॥२६॥
verses.english: Besides this, I am ready to accord whatever boon you seek from me... as such, tell me what your heart would wish for..." So said king shantanu to bhIShma.
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋतुपर्यायो वर्षापगमस्तेन शिथिलैः वृत्तं समाप्तं यन्नृत्यं तदा समुज्झितैः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: कलमापाकरम्येषु केदारेषु जनेषु च। सस्यादा जलजादाश्च मत्ता विरुरुवुः ॥२७॥
verses.english: "We hear that manes are reckoned as gods even by gods proper... then what is the difference between gods and manes... which gods do we worship and which manes do we propitiate... how the manes existing in next-world are beatified with offertories we accord here... all said and done, oh, sire, what is the result of our beatifying the manes...

verses.sanskrit: सिषिचुर्यानि जलदा जलेन जलदागमे। तानि सस्यानि बालानि कठिनत्वं गतानि वै॥२८॥
verses.english: Gods, humans, demons, yakSha-s, uragaa-s gandharvA-s, kinnaraa-s, including mahA-uragA-s and suchlike multitude is there... but, which god or gods they worship...

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा मेघमयं वासः शरद्गुणविदीपितः। एष वै विमले व्योम्नि हृष्टो वसति चन्द्रमाः॥२९॥
verses.english: As long as you wish to live the Death does not have its influence on you... it lays its icy hand on you only if you consent to it....

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरिण्यो द्विगुणं गावः प्रमत्ता द्विगुणं वृषाः। वनानां द्विगुणा लक्ष्मीः सस्यैर्गुणवती मही॥३०॥
verses.english: "I will explain all that in a nutshell as to how manes have come up, what fruits they yield, origination of manes... listen to it carefully...

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतींषि घनमुक्तानि पद्मवन्ति जलानि च। मनांसि च मनुष्याणां प्रसादमुपयान्ति वै॥३१॥
verses.english: God a priori is the root cause and everybody like manes, heavenly gods, worlds with respective gods, humans, demons, yakshaa, uraga, gandharva, kinnara, mahA-uragA-s have emanated from him... why this breed and that... everything is a posteriori to him...

verses.sanskrit: असृजत्सविता व्योम्नि निर्मुक्तो जलदैर्भृशम्। शरत्प्रज्वलितं तेजस्तीक्ष्णरश्मिर्विशोषयन्॥३२॥
verses.english: As such, all beings like gods, humans, gandharva-s et al will firstly appease that foremost god... and if he is assuaged, all the gods, manes and the rest feel assuaged... whatever is offered in the process of beatification in this world thus belongs and reaches the god a priori, say, via the intermediary manes and gods... in turn they accord benefits to the offerers in some kind or the other to keep up give-and-take syndrome... this is the cycle brahma has ordered...

verses.sanskrit: नीराजयित्वा सैन्यानि प्रयान्ति विजिगीषवः। अन्योन्यराष्ट्राभिमुखाः पार्थिवाः पृथिवीक्षितः॥३३॥
verses.english: As such, you have to firstly worship manes unindolently with श्राद्धा-s, whereby they accord all sundry benefits, because they are the accorders of fruits of actions... whether they are upward bound or downward, they receive your offerings... hence, you adore them extolling their names and ancestries - नाम गोत्रा-s...

verses.sanskrit: बन्धुजीवाभिताम्रासु बद्धपङ्कवतीषु च। मनस्तिष्ठति कान्तासु चित्रासु वनराजिषु॥३४॥
verses.english: "Then I curiously asked my father who long back left for merited worlds, yet available there in an invisible form..." Thus bhIShma continued narration to dharmaja.

verses.sanskrit: वनेषु च विराजन्ते पादपा वनशोभिनः। असनाः सप्तपर्णाश्च कोविदाराश्च पुष्पिताः॥३५॥
इषुसाह्वा निकुम्भाश्च प्रियकाः स्वर्णकास्तथा। सृमराः पेचुकाश्चैव केतक्यश्च समन्ततः॥३६॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the sixteenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the prominence of श्राद्ध-s, beatification of manes.

verses.sanskrit: व्रजेषु च विशेषेण गर्गरोद्गारहासिषु। शरत्प्रकाशयोषेव गोष्ठेष्वटति रूपिणी॥३७॥
verses.english: Gods, humans, demons, yakSha-s, uragaa-s gandharvA-s, kinnaraa-s, including mahA-uragA-s and suchlike multitude is there... but, which god or gods they worship...
verses.bhavadeepa: इषुसाह्वाः बाणासनाः निकुम्भाः दन्तिविटपाः स्वर्णकाः स्वर्णपर्णाः पुष्पिता इति पूर्वेणान्वयः। सृमरा मृगविशेषाः तेषां शरदि दर्शनात्। पेचुकाः घूका इति केचित्॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit: नूनं त्रिदशभूयिष्ठं मेघकालसुखोषितम्। पतत्रिकेतनं देवं बोधयन्ति दिवौकसः॥३८॥
verses.english: "I will explain all that in a nutshell as to how manes have come up, what fruits they yield, origination of manes... listen to it carefully...

verses.sanskrit: शरद्येवं सुसस्यायां प्राप्तायां प्रावृषः क्षये। नीलचन्द्रार्कवर्णैश्च रचितं बहुभिर्द्विजैः॥३९॥
फलैः प्रवालैश्च घनमिन्द्रचापघनोपमम्। भवनाकारविटपं लतापरममण्डितम्॥४०॥
विशालमूलावनतं पवनाभोगमण्डितम्। अर्चयामो गिरिं देवं गाश्चैव च विशेषतः॥४१॥
सावतंसैर्विषाणैश्च बर्हापीडैश्च दंशितैः। घण्टाभिश्च प्रलम्बाभिः पुष्पैः शारदिकैस्तथा॥४२॥
शिवाय गावः पूज्यन्तां गिरियज्ञः प्रवर्त्यताम्। पूज्यतां त्रिदशैः शक्रो गिरिरस्माभिरिज्यताम्॥४३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सावतंसैः समुकुटैः बर्हापीडैः मयूरपत्रभूषाभिस्तत्रैव शृङ्गेषु दंशितैर्बद्धैः॥४२॥

verses.sanskrit: कारयिष्यामि गोयज्ञं बलादपि न संशयः। यद्यस्ति मयि वः प्रीतिर्यदि वा सुहृदो वयम्॥४४॥
गावो हि पूज्याः सततं सर्वेषां नात्र संशयः। यदि साम्ना भवेत्प्रीतिर्भवतां वैभवाय च। एतन्मम वचस्तथ्यं क्रियतामविचारितम्॥४५॥
